tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the Anagent tool registry. Filter by free-text query (matches name/tagline/description), category slug, and/or interface type. Returns active tools only, newest first.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Fetch the full record for one tool by slug: description, install/connect method, capabilities, category tags, and every cited source (with source URLs) backing the record.
